source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Document assessments and care accurately, objectively, and promptly, and correct errors through the approved traceable record process.","B":"Document planned interventions before they are performed when the nurse expects to complete them by the end of the shift.","C":"Delete an inaccurate electronic entry so the original information is no longer visible in the record.","D":"Limit documentation to medications and procedures because patient responses are not part of the legal health record."}}
source_row.rationale: NCBI Nursing Fundamentals identifies EHR documentation as a legal document and states that entries should be objective, factual, accurate, and timely. Care not completed must not be charted as completed, and errors should be corrected using an appropriate traceable process rather than erased or concealed.
